x_DESCRIPTION: v3.5 §5a/5b smoke test — exercises the new multi-region terrain and multi-region weather shapes together in a single run.
x_TEST_GOALS: Verify loadRunFile parses {fallback, regions:[...]} struct shape for terrain (5a)
Verify loadRunFile parses fallback='none' + regions:[...] for weather (5a, region-only weather case)
Verify composeHeightmap stamps the mountain region over the rural fallback heightmap (5b)
Verify resolveRegionIdx fires per-detection so weather clutter only appears inside the rain polygon (5b)
Verify ground clutter density and terrain type swap inside the mountain polygon vs rural outside
Verify hasFallbackWeather=false suppresses Pass 2 weather clutter when fallback='none'
x_TARGET_PATH: Single airliner flying due east along y=0 from x=-30km to x=+30km over 240s (~900 km/h).
x_TIMING: t=0    x=-30km    OUTSIDE both polygons — rural terrain, clear sky
t=60   x=-15km    ENTERS mountain polygon — heightmap step, terrain_type flips, clutter density 0.3 -> 0.5
t=140  x=+5km     ENTERS rain polygon — weather clutter starts (mountain still active)
t=180  x=+15km    EXITS mountain polygon — back to rural fallback (rain polygon still active)
t=240  x=+30km    end of scenario, target still in rain polygon
x_EXPECTED_CONSOLE_LINES: [RUN] Weather: 1 region(s), no fallback (clear outside regions)
(in runDetections summary): rain rate scales with storm_window severity
x_NOTE_ON_LEGACY_RUNS: All 26 passing validation tests use the legacy single-string shape and will keep working unchanged. This is the first run file that uses the new struct shape end-to-end.
